title: CLAUDE.md
text: dma (Distributional Mediation Analysis) R package causal mediation analysis using energy regression (engression). implements estimation framework crumble (Liu, Williams, Rudolph & Díaz, 2024) replaces mlr3superlearner engression outcome regressions uses engression-style neural networks Riesz representer estimation. Improvements original enmediation package: - Observation weights propagated nuisance estimation (theta alpha), just EIF stage - Richer result object storing trained models, folds, data diagnostics - Coefficient plot (plot.dma_result()) counterfactual density plot (plot_counterfactual_density()) optional Riesz representer weighting (use_weights=TRUE) mediation regimes

title: CLAUDE.md
text: θ outcome regressions (theta.R): Nested pseudo-outcome cascade using engression() observation weights. Natural path: θ³(,W,Z,M→Y) → θ²(,W,Z→b3) → θ¹(,W→b2). Randomized adds θ⁴ level. Trained models stored post-hoc analysis. α density ratios (phi.R → alpha.R → riesz_nn.R): Cascaded Riesz representer NNs. level uses previous level’s output multiplied observation weights. Loss: E[α²] - 2·w·f(α,X’). EIF (eif.R): Natural: α³(Y-θ³) + α²(b3-θ²) + α¹(b2-θ¹) + b1. Randomized: 4-term version. Inference (estimates.R): Contrasts EIF components → ife objects point estimates, SEs, CIs.

text: prepare_engression_x(): One-hot encodes factor/character columns, drops zero-variance columns training, aligns prediction columns training reference via ref_cols. title: CLAUDE.md
text: Use cache: false torch-dependent chunks Rmd/vignettes Engression internally standardizes inputs — constant columns cause NaN; use prepare_engression_x() ref_cols prediction alignment S7 classes data structures (dma_vars, dma_data); S3 class output (dma_result) dma_result stores d0/d1 actual functions (unevaluated expressions match.call()) downstream code like plot_counterfactual_density() can call directly plot_counterfactual_density() two modes: (1) shift--predict (default, shows 2 marginal P(Y|(=)) distributions), (2) use_weights=TRUE (Riesz representer importance sampling, shows mediation regimes including cross-world Y(1,M(0))) Alpha structure: result$alpha_n contains alpha1..alpha3 matrices (natural), result$alpha_r contains alpha1..alpha4 (randomized). Final alpha (alpha3 alpha4) columns = regime codes (e.g., “000”, “100”, “111”) used importance weights

title: Distributional Mediation Analysis
text: dma implements causal mediation analysis engression nuisance estimation. point using distributional regression method counterfactual outcome distribution can change ways summarized conditional mean. package supports four effect decompositions: Natural (N): Direct indirect effects Organic (O): Organic direct indirect effects Randomized Interventional (RI): RIDE RIIE Recanting Twins (RT): Four-way path decomposition estimands follow Liu, Williams, Rudolph, Diaz (2024). engression used outcome regressions Riesz-representer density-ratio steps.

title: Plot counterfactual outcome densities — plot_counterfactual_density
text: Visualizes distribution outcome different treatment regimes. Two modes: (1) shift--predict using trained engression models (default), shows marginal outcome distributions P(Y|(=)); (2) weighted densities using learned Riesz representers (use_weights = TRUE), shows mediation counterfactual regimes including cross-world quantities like Y(1, M(0)).
